## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The legacy retry limit must be reduced before merge because it violates the unchanged three-attempt policy.

## Changes
The pull request adds inventory fetching and health probing with retries, immediate HTTP-error propagation, and parameterized tests. It also adds a legacy exemption to the retry documentation.

## Critical
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Cap legacy inventory fetching at three attempts — When the legacy endpoint remains unavailable, this limit permits eight attempts, violating `docs/review-rules.md:5`: “Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts.” — Repeated connection timeouts can occupy a worker for approximately 87 seconds before callers receive the final error. — Fix: Reduce the limit to three and update the expectation at `tests/test_retries.py:10`.
